title: Harry Turner investigates UAP sightings at Maralinga

tellings.quote: And he was invited to investigate multiple UAP UAP sightings that took place at Maralinga during the sightings.

plain: In the 1950s or 60s, a man named Harry Turner was invited to investigate several sightings of UAP, the official term for unidentified objects in the sky, at Maralinga in Australia. The journalist Ross Coulthart tells Michels this without naming a source, citing the researcher Bill Chalker. If true, officials at the site took the sightings seriously enough to bring someone in to look into them.
